coordinatorSummary: ACCEPT at 0 blockers and 0 SHOULD-FIX. Twenty-two attacks run, none landed. Custody holds: subject e2557af7 at 0444, 11030 bytes, unmoved at both ends; HEAD never left 5d5d778; live required-now 26 of 26; file 08 and COORD unmodified. All six cited pins reproduce, recordedInputs.HEAD equals the top-level head, and artifact and version are both 1. The dispatch states the token as a condition rather than a prohibition, so it was measured first: file08StatusToken is the bare string OPEN, the live DR-G23 status cell is OPEN, and no SATISFIED standing has leaked into it — which matters because this join's neighbourhood is full of it, between DR-133's eligibility and the D-056 Class A machinery. The assurance quote 'PROPOSED; not QUALIFIED' likewise equals the live stage cell rather than paraphrasing it. NT scope was checked in both directions, because this gate sits where two NT numbering schemes collide. All sixteen NT-bearing fields were resolved by path: NT-3 and NT-5 are the gate's classes, and NT-1, NT-2, NT-4, NT-6, NT-7 and NT-8 appear only inside refusals. The inverse also holds — G23 v1's own namedClassesThisGate is exactly NT-3 and NT-5 and its failsIf makes treating any other as a G23 class a failure, so the join neither over-claims nor under-claims. The load-bearing claim is that D-147 closed leftover-design of NT-3 and NT-5 as unnamed remainders, since that is what lets an obligation sit at leftoverDesign false, and I verified it in the adopted COORD text rather than in the artifact's account: D-147 reads that G23 owns DR-133 NT-3 and NT-5 only and that their leftover-design closes with the remainder being G23 execution. Both limbs are there. The D-146 characterization matches that decision's adopted heading, and the join carries the live required-now 26 rather than the 19 D-147 recorded at the time. The named corpus phrase is identical three ways, bookkeeping reconciles at five and five, and the omitted-obligation probe that produced a blocker on the DR-105 join came back null. Two things recorded rather than raised. The join is silent on whether D-056 gates 2 and 3 hold, where G23 v1 notes D-147 established them for all seven DR-133 NT classes; on reflection that silence is correct rather than a gap, because this is a gate row and asserting those gates would read as advancing DR-133 toward SATISFIED, which the dispatch forbids. And the DR-G23 harness cell still reads 'not authored' while G23 v1 exists — the seventh row in that condition after DR-G09, DR-G15, DR-G26, DR-G16, DR-G07 and DR-G10. The artifact handles it correctly by measuring the close and leaving the recording to a later D-000 act, and I continue to fold this into the standing recommendation that the coordinator dispose of the family in one act rather than raising a seventh separate advisory.
